topic: A cheerful cartoon orange mascot hops into frame, slips on a banana peel, spins, and lands in a funny victory pose ready for meme compositing
prompt_goal: Create one cartoon SFX-driven single-video prompt on a clean green screen so the subject can be composited later.
main_subject: A cheerful orange cartoon mascot with white gloves, big shoes, and highly readable expressive eyes.
setting: A clean chroma-green studio setup intended for easy background replacement later.
action: The mascot bounces into frame, slips on a banana peel, spins with exaggerated cartoon timing, and lands in a funny victory pose.
blocking_and_staging: Keep the mascot centered with enough space for the slip and spin, making the whole body readable for later compositing.
foreground_midground_background: Use clean subject-to-camera spacing, clear floor contact, and open margins around the mascot instead of scenic depth.
must_include: clean green screen, banana peel, readable full-body silhouette, exaggerated cartoon timing
avoid: spoken dialogue, extra props, scenic background, muddy edges, green clothing details that blend into the background
